hypothesis: Preserve the original R9 cheap agricultural admission, then allow at most one additional future-labor-failed project to seek complete route and cash approval per frame. Restrict costly queries, not the original feasible expansion.
integration_point: After the original cheap agricultural admission loop, before original BUY_LAND logic; final agricultural baseline must include every accepted project and existing obligation.
cheap_phase: Original R9 budget/funding/score/Router/selection/commit order unchanged; no future-route rescue inside either old loop.

rescue_selection.candidates: Rebuild quotes at final agricultural baseline, excluding reserved/plant_permits and original animal restrictions. Require positive exact original marginal net, current-day labor pass, at least one future legacy labor failure, original non-route affordability.
rescue_selection.scoring: Exact original net_cash_model and selection_score, including marginal hires and owned-wheat opportunity. No approximate gross proxy.
rescue_selection.router: Adaptive rescue searches original four expert item sets; fixed router confines rescue to that expert. Original chosen remains original; record rescue_expert and rescue_score separately.
rescue_selection.tie_break: Original descending selection_score, distance to home, position; original enumeration order resolves exact ties.
rescue_selection.limit: At most one selected q and one route_admission per frame; each route at most max(0,29-day) scheduler/checker calls. No second q after rejection.
rescue_selection.failed_cycle: Seat-local stable item/position/target-kind identity. Failed rescue keys skipped while untried eligible keys exist; ordinary step/day/price/movement does not reset. When eligible pool exhausted, mark reset for a later frame, do not restart and query twice in same frame. No cached PASS or authorization across frames.

final_admission: Full P2 original source coverage, conditional compiler, scheduler, independent checker and every postcondition; same trial must also pass original prefix_admission after route. Commit once only after both gates.
commit: Reuse original agricultural commit logic for exactly one rescue q; update funding/work/feed/material/seeds/orders/reserved/accepted/model/sources together. Failure leaves baseline business fields unchanged and ordinary care continues.
scores: Never write unapproved rescue estimates into admitted expert/crop scores or permits. Approved crop q may update that crop score and crop_choice; original expert score diagnostics remain tied to cheap scan; rescue diagnostics separate.
unchanged: All existing field assets, contracts, in-transit and already accepted cheap obligations remain represented
Original costs, capacities, current-day labor guard and cash prefix formula
Compiler/scheduler/checker bytes and P2 compact evidence rules
Existing procurement, executor, return threshold and animal care
Original land decision runs afterward using updated shared cash; displacement of land by rescue is an explicit policy tradeoff
not_claimed: Every failed route is globally infeasible
One route means one daily solver
One extra permit means actual purchase or plant
A static query bound guarantees <1 second or gold
engineering: Freeze new source and narrow control fixtures before execution; no P0/P1/P2 reruns. Saved P1/P2 and existing R9 records may be read as references. No candidate/quote/solver/engine execution authorized by this static scope.
development_gates: Original R10 >=20% late produced non-WHEAT sales per opponent with seat non-regression, R0/R9 paired strength gates and all G0-G5 remain necessary. Added scheduling changes require explicit protocol addendum before new full matches; old failed results and thresholds stay frozen.
